title: This Expensive Chip Stock Is Up 140%, Analysts Say It’s Still a Buy
author: Sam Quirke
description: Lattice Semiconductor Corporation has surged 140% since April 2025 lows and is trading at an extreme P/E ratio of around 4,000, far exceeding peers like NVIDIA (35x) and AMD (77x). Despite the frothy valuation, Wall Street remains bullish with price targets suggesting 10%+ upside, citing the company's consistent earnings beats and strong forward guidance. However, the stock carries significant risk due to its lack of margin for error and broader semiconductor cycle pressures.

title: Trump Blocks $2.9 Million HieFo-Emcore Chip Deal Over China-Linked National Security Concerns
author: Mohd Haider
description: President Trump signed an executive order blocking a $2.9 million semiconductor deal between HieFo Corp. and Emcore Corp., citing national security concerns related to China. HieFo must divest all interests in Emcore's chip business and indium phosphide wafer fabrication operations within 180 days. This move is part of Trump's broader strategy to restrict Chinese access to advanced semiconductor technologies.

While this protects AMD's market position, the mention is indirect and part of broader policy discussion rather than directly impacting AMD's operations.

title: Lattice Semi: Investors Who Missed This Sell Signal Are Now Counting a 37% Loss
author: Investing.Com
description: Lattice Semiconductor (LSCC) and Five Below (FIVE) experienced significant stock price declines after the InvestingPro Fair Value tool accurately predicted their overvaluation, helping investors avoid steep losses.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article states that Lattice Semiconductor's stock surged over 350% after the pandemic, but the InvestingPro Fair Value tool had flagged the stock as overvalued, predicting a potential 37% downside. The stock subsequently dropped 37%, leaving investors who missed the sell signal with significant losses.

The article explains that the InvestingPro Fair Value tool identified a disconnect between Five Below's fundamentals and its soaring share price, issuing a signal warning that the stock was overvalued by 57.83%. The stock later tumbled 53.63% from its highs, proving the tool's accuracy in predicting the overvaluation.
